sources.name: NYC Cooling Tower Registrations
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is normalized current systems represented in the generated product.

sources.name: NYC Cooling Tower System Inspection Results
sources.entity_unit: current cooling tower systems with published inspection history
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of current systems with at least one exact system_id inspection history; it is not an expected-completeness percentage.

sources.name: OATH Hearings Division Case Status
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is exact NYC Health summons_number to OATH ticket_number match coverage.

sources.name: Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BBL match coverage; one BBL can attach to more than one cooling-tower system.

sources.name: DOB NOW: Build – Job Application Filings
sources.entity_unit: BBLs with DOB NOW job filings
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BBL job-filing coverage. A missing DOB NOW match means no matching DOB NOW job filing was returned; it is not evidence that no construction or mechanical work ever occurred.

sources.name: Multiple Dwelling Registrations
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BBL registration match coverage. HPD registration applies only to qualifying properties, so low absolute coverage is not itself a failure.

sources.name: Registration Contacts
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of exact-matched HPD registration BBLs with public contact rows.

sources.name: NYC Planimetric Database: Cooling Towers
sources.entity_unit: current cooling-tower BINs with mapped physical tower features
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of current registry BINs with at least one exact-BIN 2022 aerial-derived Planimetric cooling-tower feature. A missing physical match is not evidence that a registered tower does not exist, and a building-level physical feature is not a one-to-one System ID identity claim.

sources.name: BUILDING
sources.entity_unit: current cooling-tower BINs with current NYC building footprints
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is exact BIN attachment of the current NYC OTI building-footprint layer. The footprint is used as roof/building context and does not change cooling-tower identity, compliance status, or Priority Score.

sources.name: New York State Cooling Tower Registry Weekly Extract
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is the share of current authoritative NYS extract rows represented by normalized unique Equipment_ID records. Missing coordinates do not remove equipment from the product.

sources.name: NYC ACRIS recent property activity cache
sources.entity_unit: cooling-tower BBLs with relevant ACRIS activity in the bounded window
sources.coverage_note: Coverage is observed 365-day relevant-document activity prevalence across exact cooling-tower BBLs, not a source-completeness target. A BBL without a cached match is not evidence that no property transaction or filing ever occurred.
